components.name: confidence
components.definition: generator interface pTM, supplied by the caller; tcren does not compute it

components.name: energy
components.definition: structural poly-alanine reference difference on the TCR:peptide interface, the epitope positions truncated to alanine in 3D with the contact map rebuilt (scoring --delta --reference-mode structural)

standardization: means and scales frozen on a held-out training pool of 729 models over 14 off-panel epitopes; no label was read to produce them, so this is a change of units and not a fit
sign_source: fixed a priori by what each component means; the training pool is used only to check them, and each component records the pool's verdict
combination: weighted Stouffer over the standardized components, sum(w z)/sqrt(sum w^2); the confidence block carries default_weight and the structural components share the remainder equally
